verdict.rationale: Featurebase's marketing page directly claims one-click integrations with third-party tools ('Connect Featurebase with your favorite tools in just a few clicks'), but the evidence pack provides no list of specific supported integrations, no screenshots, or independent confirmation of the setup flow. missing for 10: named integration list (e.g., Slack, Jira, Intercom), hands-on/independent verification of the 'few clicks' setup, and details on which tools are supported out of the box.
